'''Escargot''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. Five can be purchased from [[Gus]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|30|calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s each. One Escargot may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].

==Tailoring==
